ch: With Who's Coming, you make your groups once.
Each question gets a card on the Asks tab.
Now go to the Asks tab and tap the big button, Ask the group something.
Setting up Who's Coming takes about five minutes.
Step three: in the new group, type each person's name and mobile number and tap Add.
Step five: pick the group, type your question, and choose how they can answer.
Step seven: when someone answers, by text, by phone or in person, tap their answer on…
